description: Project foundation: scaffold the repository structure, author docs/PMR3407_RULES.md (formal rules with source attributions and an Ambiguities section), author the Kiro Spec (requirements.md EARS-style, design.md with domain model + pipeline, tasks.md ordered plan), establish the zero-dependency test harness (Node v22 native TS + `node --test`), and implement the two foundational, method-independent layers everything else depends on: the DOMAIN MODEL (types) and the SEQUENCE PARSER. This feature is independent of any solver method.
steps: Create directory tree under /projects/sandbox: src/{domain,parser,engine/{intuitive,cascade,step-by-step},validator,layout,renderer/{pneumatic,electrical},simulator,ui}, tests/{parser,engine,golden,properties}, docs/.

Write package.json (name pmr3407-pneumatic-circuit-generator, type=module, private=true) with scripts: "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json", "test": "node --test \"tests/**/*.test.ts\" \"src/**/*.test.ts\"". Do NOT add dependencies that require npm install; leave dependencies empty (registry is blocked). Add a README note that Node v22 is required and NODE_OPTIONS must be unset.

Write tsconfig.json: module=nodenext, moduleResolution=nodenext, target=es2022, lib=[es2022], strict=true, noEmit=true, allowImportingTsExtensions=true, verbatimModuleSyntax=true, isolatedModules=true, skipLibCheck=true. isolatedModules+verbatimModuleSyntax help keep code within Node's strip-only subset.

Author docs/PMR3407_RULES.md using the load-bearing facts supplied by the orchestrator: sequence notation (letter + +/-, T timer prefix, parentheses = simultaneous movements in one step); direct vs indirect sequence definition and signal-overlap consequence; element numbering (cylinders 1.0/2.0/3.0/4.0; main valve N.1; limit/signal valves N.2/N.3; flow-control 1.0x; supply 0.x); electropneumatic naming (1S1/1S2 sensors, 1Y1/1Y2 solenoids, K relays, KC counter, boxed-delay time relays, NO/NC contacts, +24V/0V rails); the THREE step-by-step rules verbatim (prev line active; prev event sensor tripped; new line de-energizes previous) and the SELO/seal sub-circuit + extra rung to arm the last line; the cascade group-division algorithm (same letter opposite sign cannot share a group; Nm = groups-1; last-into-first merge optimization; line activation on last event of previous group + memory reset); the intuitive 5-phase method; cycle single vs continuous; emergency. Attribute each rule to its deck/exercise where the orchestrator briefing states it. Include a dedicated '## Ambiguities / Open Questions' section covering at minimum: the .2-vs-.3 limit-valve retracted/advanced convention (pick ONE convention explicitly and justify), the S1-vs-S2 end mapping, exact group-merge edge cases, and any rule lacking sufficient evidence. Pick and STATE the chosen conventions so the solver is deterministic.

Author .kiro/specs/pmr3407-pneumatic-circuit-generator/requirements.md: EARS-style testable requirements ('WHEN ... THE SYSTEM SHALL ...') covering parsing (all accepted formats + each rejection example A++, AB+, A+X, ++B with useful messages), actuator auto-detection, explicit initial state (default A0/B0/C0 but overridable), step interpretation incl. simultaneous groups and timers, step-by-step activation/seal/transition/deactivation logic, cascade group division, electropneumatic vs pneumatic separation, validator checks (the full list the user enumerated), cycle single/continuous, textual explanation derivation, and property invariants.

Author .kiro/specs/pmr3407-pneumatic-circuit-generator/design.md: the domain model (Sequence, Movement{actuator,direction}, Cylinder{id,currentState}, Sensor{id,actuator,position}, DirectionalValve, Relay, Contact, Coil, Memory, Step, CascadeGroup, Connection{sourceComponent,sourcePort,targetComponent,targetPort,signalType}, Circuit) expressed as string-literal unions + interfaces (NO enums - Node strip-only forbids them); the full pipeline with responsibilities; the rule that the renderer never decides logic; component state models for future simulation (Cylinder RETRACTED/MOVING_FORWARD/EXTENDED/MOVING_BACKWARD, Relay ON/OFF, Sensor ACTIVE/INACTIVE, Valve STATE_1/STATE_2). Document the environment/dependency constraints (no npm registry, native TS, no enums).
Author .kiro/specs/pmr3407-pneumatic-circuit-generator/tasks.md: ordered implementation plan mirroring these features, noting a task is DONE only when its tests pass. List the selected golden tests.

Implement src/domain: define the intermediate representation as interfaces + string-literal union types (Direction = '+' | '-'; component/state unions via `as const`). Export a barrel module. Include explicit InitialState representation (map actuator -> 'retracted'|'extended') defaulting to all retracted but constructible with other states.

Implement src/parser: a tokenizer + normalizer. Accept 'A+B+A-B-', space-separated, semicolon-separated, and lowercase inputs; support timer prefix T and parenthesized simultaneous groups (e.g. 'A+B-T(A-B-)B+'). Normalize to a canonical SequenceModel (ordered list of Steps, each Step = one-or-more Movements, optional timer flag). Auto-detect actuators. Reject invalid sequences (A++, AB+, A+X, ++B, unbalanced parens) with specific, useful error messages. Provide a Result-style return (ok/value or error/message) rather than throwing for expected parse errors.

Write tests/parser/*.test.ts covering: each accepted format normalizes to the same canonical model; lowercase normalizes to uppercase; timer and simultaneous-group parsing; every rejection example yields an error with a helpful message; actuator auto-detection. Write a small tests/properties/_arbitrary.ts helper (hand-rolled random sequence generator with a fixed seed + basic shrinking) since fast-check is not installable, and add tests/properties for parser round-trip / actuator-coverage invariants.

Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts" "src/**/*.test.ts"` and confirm both pass before marking complete. Record results and any dependency limitation in findings.
acceptance_criteria: docs/PMR3407_RULES.md exists with rules attributed to decks/exercises and a non-empty 'Ambiguities / Open Questions' section that explicitly picks the .2/.3 and S1/S2 conventions.
.kiro/specs/pmr3407-pneumatic-circuit-generator/{requirements.md,design.md,tasks.md} all exist; requirements are EARS-style and testable; design contains the domain model and pipeline.
`unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0 (no enums / no strip-mode-illegal syntax).
`unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts" "src/**/*.test.ts"` passes with parser tests for all accepted formats and all four rejection examples (A++, AB+, A+X, ++B).
The parser returns identical canonical SequenceModel for 'A+B+A-B-', 'A+ B+ A- B-', 'A+;B+;A-;B-', and 'a+b+a-b-'.
The domain model compiles as pure types with no runtime enum usage and no third-party imports.
findings:
COMPLETED. Scaffolded the full directory tree, package.json (type=module, zero deps, scripts typecheck/test), and tsconfig.json (nodenext, strict, noEmit, allowImportingTsExtensions, verbatimModuleSyntax, isolatedModules, skipLibCheck, plus noUncheckedIndexedAccess). Authored docs/PMR3407_RULES.md (rules attributed to decks/exercises + a dedicated Ambiguities section that explicitly picks .2=retracted/.3=advanced and S1=retracted/S2=advanced, plus cascade merge, timer defaults, T-reserved-letter, group ordering conventions). Authored the Kiro spec: requirements.md (EARS WHEN/SHALL, tagged F1 vs F2+), design.md (domain model + full pipeline + renderer-never-decides-logic + env constraints), tasks.md (ordered plan with milestones and 6 selected golden exercises). Implemented src/domain (interfaces + string-literal unions, NO enums; explicit InitialState defaulting all-retracted but overridable; Result type) and src/parser (tokenizer + parser accepting compact/spaced/semicolon/lowercase, timers T, simultaneous groups (), actuator auto-detection, canonicalization with alphabetical group ordering, Result-style rejections for A++, AB+, A+X, ++B, unbalanced/empty/nested parens, dangling timer, dup-in-group).

ENVIRONMENT FINDING (important for later features): @types/node cannot be installed (npm registry 403). Without it `tsc --noEmit` fails on node:test/node:assert imports. Solution: hand-written ambient declarations in types/node-shims.d.ts covering node:test, node:assert/strict, node:process; tsconfig includes types/**/*.d.ts. Do NOT add "types":["node"] to tsconfig (requires @types/node). Extend node-shims.d.ts when a new Node built-in is needed. Every shell must `unset NODE_OPTIONS` first.

VERIFICATION: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0. `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts" "src/**/*.test.ts"` => 27 tests pass, 0 fail (parser: accepted-formats, timers-and-groups, rejections incl. all four mandated examples, actuator-detection; properties: dialect-equivalence, canonical round-trip, actuator-coverage via hand-rolled Rng+forAll+shrinker since fast-check is not installable). Committed on branch feat/pmr3407-foundation (session started on default branch master, so a new branch was created; not pushed).
